text:
micah: Pushed RC rc-482c to candidate queue (build 482c). /deploybot create-rc rc-482c --tags=canary
micah: Q for sheriff: can we promote into the 1pm change window (starts in ~40m)?
deploy-bot: [automated] RC created rc-482c | artifact: registry.redwood/release/rc-482c | staged for canary
nisha: did a quick smoke on staging, seeing embedding failures (502s). logs:
```
embed-service ERROR 2026-03-21T16:10:02 connection timeout to redis-kv
Trace: timeout after 2s
```
anna: looks like KV warm didn't finish from the earlier bake. I'm restarting the kv-warm job now.
micah: ok — what's the risk if we promote the canary at 5% while kv-warm still finishing? Fall back target is v481 if things go bad.
jane-sheriff: @micah hold for now — need a telemetry baseline for 30m post-kv-warm. If embed errors continue we abort. Also please pin fallback artifact in prod for a quick rollback.
micah: ack. Pinning v481 now and preparing rollback snippet.
micah: rollback snippet:
```
# rollback to v481
/deploybot promote --artifact=registry.redwood/release/v481 --route=prod --reason="rollback from rc-482c"
```
anna: KV warm status: warming 60/60 shards; ETA ~5m
deploy-bot: [automated] KV warm complete
nisha: re-ran smoke after warm — embeds look healthy, only a small p95 latency spike (+120ms).
micah: quick telemetry check: no client error rate increase, latency bump within SLOs.
jane-sheriff: ok — green light for a 5% canary but no full promote until canary metrics hold for 25m. Set canary flag and schedule a telemetry checkpoint at +20m.
micah: done. /deploybot promote --artifact=registry.redwood/release/rc-482c --route=canary --percent=5
deploy-bot: [automated] Promotion to canary started. route=canary percent=5. Rollout ID: rto-20260321-482c
anna: can we add an auto-fallback policy to revert to v481 if errors >1% for a sustained 5m window?
micah: added policy: auto-fallback -> v481 on error_rate >1% sustained 5m.
nisha: noted, continuing telemetry watch. I'll post a short readout at +10m.
micah: thanks — tagging oncall @eng-oncall for awareness. :eyes:
jane-sheriff: thanks everyone. Keep updates in this thread; if anything looks off we abort and pin back.
micah: will update.
